newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche MG downgrades Hoechst shares.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche MG downgrades Hoechst shares.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell on Wednesday downgraded shares in chemicals and drugs group Hoechst AG to neutral from overweight after the company shelved plans to list its drugs group HMR on the bourse.
"It simply hailed bad news at Hoechst today," said Deutsche analyst Katharina Uhlenbrock.

"Profits were worse than expected and there was weakness in the operating business, the company decided not to list the drugs division," which managed to seriously shake investor trust in the group, she added.
More losses were likely after the share dropped to a low of 68 marks and ending bourse trade down 10.31 percent at 70.45 marks, she said. --Svea Herbst-Bayliss, Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525.
